meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用访谈式提问帮您打磨计划与设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常常需要把不成熟的想法梳理得清晰可行
copy.tagline_en: Hone your plan or design through relentless questioning.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to sharpen rough ideas into clear plans.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以替你跑一场 /grilling 环节：围绕你的方案或设计做一场持续追问的访谈，用来打磨它。该技能已关闭模型自动调用，需要你自己发起。
howto.when: 需要你主动调用才会开始，Claude 不会自行接管（技能中已关闭模型自动调用）。当你想打磨一份方案或设计、让它经得起追问时用它。

say.note: 开始一场围绕该方案的持续追问访谈

say.text: 用 /grilling 追问我这个设计
say.note: 开始针对这份设计连续提问

say.text: 对我的产品方案做一次 /grilling 访谈
say.note: 进入 /grilling，围绕产品方案追问

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can run a /grilling session: a relentless interview that questions your plan or design to sharpen it. Model invocation is disabled, so you have to start it yourself.
howto.when_en: It only starts when you invoke it yourself; Claude will not take over automatically (model invocation is disabled). Use it when you want to sharpen a plan or design.

say_en.text: Run a /grilling session on this plan
say_en.note: Starts a relentless interview about the plan

say_en.text: Use /grilling to interview me about this design
say_en.note: Starts repeated questioning on the design
Enters /grilling and questions the product plan
